title: 新加坡监狱署试验自主安保机器人
titleEn: Singapore Prison Service trials autonomous security robot
summary: 新加坡监狱署与HTX合作开发的自主安保机器人PROTECT将从十月起在监狱试验，用于巡逻和应对犯人骚乱。
summaryEn: The Singapore Prison Service will deploy PROTECT, an autonomous security robot developed with HTX, to patrol and respond to inmate disturbances in a three-month trial starting October.
speaker: The Straits Times
